test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

My grandfather said, ”Always respect the National Flag.”

options.text: My grandfather said that respect the national flag always.
My grandfather wished to respect the national flag always.
My grandfather advised me to respect the national flag always.
My grandfather asked if I respect the national flag always.

solution:
The correct answer is **"My grandfather advised me to respect the national flag always." **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in direct speech, which means it is being quoted directly from the speaker (the grandfather).
 
• In indirect speech, the speaker's words are reported indirectly, usually with a reporting verb like "**said**," "**told**," or "**advised**."
 
• When changing direct speech to indirect speech, the tense and pronouns may need to be adjusted to fit the new context.
 
• In this case, "always respect" becomes "to respect always" and "the National Flag" becomes "the national flag."

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 **is incorrect because it uses the present tense ("respect") instead of the infinitive ("to respect") and does not change the capitalization of "National Flag."
 
• **Option 2 **is incorrect because it changes the meaning of the sentence from a directive to a wish.
 
• **Option 4 **is incorrect because it changes the sentence from a statement to a question.
